landing.heroSub: Describe your product in one message and add a photo. Campio reads the eMAG market, finds your audience, writes your listing and ads, plans four weeks of budget and makes short videos.
landing.heroNote: Market numbers come from real eMAG data and are computed by code, not guessed by AI.

how.d: Write freely and add photos. The AI asks only for what is missing, like price or ad budget.
~60 eMAG competitors with prices and reviews, Google Trends, plus Amazon.de, Reddit and BetaList.
Personas, positioning, listing, ads, a 4-week plan with A/B tests and AI-made videos.

landing.bentoTitle: Everything to launch on eMAG, in one kit.
landing.bentoSub: What an agency would do in the first weeks, ready in about a minute, with every number traceable to data.

bento.d: Price distribution, median vs your price, ratings, top sellers and a 5-year Google Trends curve.
Amazon.de prices, Reddit discussions and new products on BetaList, when available.
2–3 personas with motivations, objections and where they spend time online.
Competitors' complaints turned into messages you can prove.
eMAG titles, description, bullets, keywords, ads per channel and social posts.
Budget per channel with estimated impressions, clicks, orders and ROAS.
Message A vs B with the sample size, cost and days each test needs.
Clips from a video model, edited into a vertical reel by an AI editor.
The real cost of the kit, and a chat that rewrites copy and simulates budgets.

landing.panelTitle: Code computes the numbers. AI writes the words.
landing.panelBody: Market stats, the budget split, impressions, clicks, orders, ROAS and A/B sample sizes are computed from data and fixed channel benchmarks. The AI picks the strategy and writes copy, and is not allowed to invent figures.
panelPoints: Prices, ratings and reviews from the first eMAG results page
Estimates from fixed CPM, CTR and conversion benchmarks per channel
A/B sample size from a two-proportion z-test (α 0.05, 80% power)
landing.priceTitle: See exactly what your kit cost.
landing.priceNote: Every kit shows its real AI, data and video cost next to your ad budget.

faq.q: Are the numbers made up by AI?
faq.a: No. Market statistics, budget splits, estimates and A/B test sizes are computed by code from eMAG data and fixed channel benchmarks. The AI chooses the strategy and writes the copy.

faq.q: Where does the market data come from?
faq.a: The first eMAG search page for your keyword (about 60 products), the most-reviewed product pages, Google Trends for Romania, and, when reachable, Amazon.de, Reddit and BetaList. Each source shows whether it was live, cached or skipped.

faq.q: Do I have to fill in a form?
faq.a: No. Write one message and add photos if you have them. If the price or budget is missing, Campio asks, with quick answers based on market prices. You can skip and we note the default we used.

faq.q: Does Campio post ads for me?
faq.a: No. You get the copy, plan and videos to publish yourself. Estimates are based on benchmarks, not guarantees.
Accounts use hashed passwords, two-step verification and private sessions. Campaigns, uploads and videos belong to your account.
